title: Spotube theme (theme.json)
description: Theme format 1.4.0. Semver: a theme of the same major always loads; a newer minor loads with its newer parts ignored. Latest 1.x: https://docs.spotube.org/schemas/theme/1.json

schema.description: The theme schema version this theme is written for (semver), for example "1.4.0".

id.description: Stable identifier; must equal the package folder name.

version.description: The theme's own version (not the schema version).

contact.description: An email address or an http(s) URL.

license.description: SPDX identifier; ship the full text as LICENSE.

logo.description: Path of a .png (max 512x512) inside the package.

updates.description: GitHub release based update checks (since 1.2.0). Release tags must be semantic versions, with or without a leading v, and the release must have an asset with this name.

asset.description: Name of the theme .zip in each release, for example my-theme.zip

parameters.description: Settings offered to users (`{params.name}`), at most 24.

vars.description: The author's private token store (`{vars.name}`).

icons.description: Per-icon replacements keyed by the app icon vector name.

iconPack.description: Restyles every app icon through icon roles (Lucide names). Either an icon font (`font` + `icons`, 1.0) or a PNG per role (`images`, 1.1).

images.description: Role -> PNG path (since 1.1.0). Works for any icon library.

tint.description: Recolour the PNGs with the icon colour (default true; best for monochrome art).

interaction.description: Hover/press lighting of rows and tabs.

app.description: App-wide fills: the backdrop behind every screen, panels/rows and small raised pieces.

panel.description: Fill of the app's own panels, cards and rows (settings groups, plugin lists, media list tiles...). Unset: the glossy panel gradient, or the flat surface colour when `tokens.surface.glow` is false. (1.4.0)

bevel.description: Fill of chips, icon boxes and artwork placeholders. Unset: the neutral bevel, or the flat raised colour when `tokens.surface.glow` is false. (1.4.0)

defaults.description: Properties applied to every component that has them, for example `{ "shape": 12 }`.

states.description: Properties per interaction state; they win over `base` in that state.

vars.description: Variables local to this component (they shadow global ones).

variants.description: One entry per slot/variant; a `base` above applies to all of them, so put slot-specific properties here.

color.description: A colour: #RGB, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA, a reference, an appearance pair or an expression. `null` clears a nullable colour.

brush.description: A colour or a gradient expression (`linear`, `gradient`, `radial`, `sweep`, `gel`).

number.description: A number (dp, fraction, count) or an expression.

shape.description: A corner radius, "pill", "rect" or four corner radii.

padding.description: A number, [horizontal, vertical], [start, top, end, bottom] or an object.

textStyle.description: Merged onto the default text style.

motion.description: Button motion: stateChangeMillis, hoverScale, pressedScale, scaleDampingRatio...
